initial_requirements: Ejada needs a supply chain management system to coordinate delivery of its information-technology products, consulting, and related services. Staff should be able to manage customer service, procurement, supplier and material selection, product development, manufacturing flow, physical distribution, outsourcing, and partnerships. The system should also help the company assess cost, productivity, assets, service, and quality performance across the supply chain.
